ResStock Measure Documentation: Heat Pump Water Heater

item.text:
The ResStock 2025 Release 1 heat pump water heater upgrade assumes a **240V unit with a uniform energy factor (UEF) of at least 3.3 and a first hour rating (FHR) of at least 45 gal/h**. **120V units are explicitly excluded**, even though they can qualify for ENERGY STAR. See *ResStock Measure Documentation: Heat Pump Water Heater*, §1–1.1, printed p. 2. ([Report](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96826.pdf#page=10))

For precision, those are the summary minimums; the final modeling uses **UEFs of 3.78, 3.95, and 3.98** for 50-, 66-, and 80-gallon tanks, respectively (Table 3, printed p. 4). ([Report, Table 3](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96826.pdf#page=12))
